summary.text: Robert P. Henri is an independent candidate for Oklahoma's 5th District and the founder of Project Due Course, a proposed package of 18 government-reform measures. According to his campaign website and Ballotpedia survey, he describes himself as a non-politician from a working-class background running on government accountability and transparency.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, his full name is Robert Patrick Henri, and he says his father named him in part after Patrick Henry.

Describes himself as coming from a working-class background and as a husband and father; says he is not a politician and that he started thinking seriously about politics after the Patriot Act was passed following 9/11.
Founded Project Due Course, a platform of 18 proposed government reforms that his campaign website says was designed to give working-class citizens a tool to improve trust in government.
